description: Start an inbox placement test for a mailbox you send from. Send one email from the mailbox you want to test to every address in seedEmails, with the testId anywhere in the body, then poll deliverability_get_test about once a minute to see whether it landed in the inbox, spam or a tab at Gmail, Outlook and other providers. Most seeds report within 2-5 minutes; the test closes 60 minutes after it starts. Charges 25 credits.
name: deliverability_create_test

seedEmails.description: Send the test email to every one of these addresses

testId.description: Put this anywhere in the body of the test email

title: Start an inbox placement test for a mailbox you send from
